name: @presslabz/web
//: The public site. It reads Postgres through packages/db rather than calling the API: one installation serving one site, and tag collection has to happen where the reading does.
//dev: --force because Astro 7 keeps one dev server per project and refuses a second. Under turbo that refusal fails the whole `pnpm dev` pipeline — the API and the admin go down with it — over a server left running by an earlier session. Replacing it is what a person means by running dev again.
//telemetry: Astro phones home with anonymous build data by default. A self-hosted CMS whose whole argument is that it keeps what it runs does not do that, so every script here opts out rather than relying on a per-machine `astro telemetry disable`.
//typecheck: tsc rather than `astro check`: the Astro language server needs the TypeScript programmatic API, which the native TS 7 compiler this repository runs does not ship (withastro/roadmap#1321). tsc covers the .ts modules; `astro build` is what compiles and rejects a broken .astro template, which is why CI runs it.
